misconceptions.cofunction-swap: Swapped sine and cosine (or tangent and cotangent).
misconceptions.composition-is-product: Multiplied the functions. Composition feeds one into the other.
misconceptions.denominator-positive: Required the bottom to be positive. It only has to be nonzero.
misconceptions.forgot-denominator: Forgot that the bottom can't be zero.
misconceptions.forgot-negative-root: Missed the negative root: x² = r² has two solutions.
misconceptions.forgot-to-flip: Divided an inequality by a negative number without flipping it.
misconceptions.horizontal-as-vertical: Turned a sideways shift into an up/down shift.
misconceptions.inequality-flip: Flipped the inequality without dividing by a negative.
misconceptions.inverse-is-reciprocal: Took 1/f(x). The −1 in f⁻¹ means 'undo', not a power.
misconceptions.kept-extraneous: Kept a root that makes a log's argument negative. Logs only take positive inputs.
misconceptions.log-of-sum: Added the arguments. log A + log B = log(AB), a product.
misconceptions.log-of-zero: Allowed zero inside a log. log 0 is undefined: the inside must be strictly positive.
misconceptions.logs-multiply: Multiplied the logs. log A + log B = log(AB).
misconceptions.miscounted-power: Miscounted the power: check by multiplying it out.
misconceptions.only-zero-matters: Only excluded the point where the inside is zero; negatives are the real problem.
misconceptions.order-swapped: Composed in the wrong order: f(g(x)) means do g first.
misconceptions.picked-wrong-root: Kept the root that makes a log's argument negative and dropped the valid one.
misconceptions.quadrant-sign: Got the sign wrong for that quadrant.
misconceptions.reference-slip: Used the wrong reference angle (π/6 and π/3 swap their sine and cosine).
misconceptions.shift-sign: Shifted the wrong way: (x − h) moves the graph right by h.
misconceptions.solved-wrong: Slipped a sign while solving for y.
misconceptions.special-value-mixup: Mixed up the special values (1/2, √2/2, √3/2 belong to different angles).
misconceptions.stretch-inside: Put the stretch inside the function, which squeezes the graph sideways instead.
misconceptions.strict-for-root: Excluded zero under a square root. √0 = 0 is fine.
misconceptions.vertical-sign: Shifted down instead of up (or the reverse).
misconceptions.wrong-quadrant: Placed the angle in the wrong quadrant.
